description: Minify JavaScript using the real Terser engine with compression and mangling, showing genuine errors and byte savings.

faqs.a: It loads the Terser library and runs Terser.minify with compress and mangle enabled — the same engine many build tools use.
Yes. If your code has a syntax error, Terser reports the real error message with its location instead of silently failing.
faqs.q: Will it show me syntax errors in my code?

faqs.a: No. The Terser library loads from a CDN, but your code is minified locally in the browser and never sent anywhere.

howto: Paste your JavaScript into the input box.
Click Minify JS and wait a moment for Terser to run.
Check the output, or read the real error message if your code has a syntax problem.
Copy the result or download it as a .min.js file.
title: JS Minifier
